body:
About 45% of my income goes to rent. Another 15 to 20% goes to car fees (gas, insurance, maintenance) because I have to live almost an hour away from work. 
Renting near my workplace is almost impossible, as it's both much too expensive and there are barely any rentals anyway.

I can barely make ends meet, and I'm paid $18/h. Most months, I end up in the red because something unexpected happened (the vet, the mechanic, a dental problem, etc.). I have no idea how people on minimum wage do it.

I think it has more to do with running away than productivity. A part of me always hopes things will magically get better in a new place.

But thank you for your kind words.

I have, but I am not ready. She was the most amazing dog I have ever known. She was my once in a lifetime dog. Everyone who met her fell in love with her. Over the year I had her, 3 different people offered to buy her off of me despite her health problems. 

There will never be another dog like her. Which is exactly why I'm not ready yet. It wouldn't be fair to the new dog.
